dag.description: Four same-priority DAGs arrive together: a data pipeline, a data-heavy fan-out, a fork-join, and independent mixed tasks. Probes heterogeneity-aware placement, DAG ordering, and data locality.

priority.description: Best-effort pressure fills the cluster, then a critical workflow and three batch workflows arrive. Probes priority handling and preemption.

cluster.evidence_scope: single-host Kind worker containers with Docker cgroup caps, emulated speeds, and tc-netem links; not independent machines
